messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick capture from today's SummitCare renewal touchpoint. Procurement said they can't sign until exports include stable export_id + per-route detail. Renewal meeting moved from Friday -> next Tue unless we unblock.
Aisha (CS): Customer verbatim: "We need a repeatable CSV export with route_id, export_id, and timestamp. Our auditors require a stable key to reconcile line items."
Tom (AM): We're on thin ice here. Procurement said they scanned our console and couldn't map charges to internal GL codes. If we don't provide a sample they will delay payment.
Marco (PM): OK let's prioritize. Short-term mitigation: produce a reconciled CSV and a one-off audit bundle. Long-term: console column + programmatic export API. Rank: export_id+route columns = P0.
Deepa (Eng): Technical notes: exporter lives in infra/export-service. Adding export_id and route_id columns is a small schema change. I can open a PR to add fields: 
```
csv_columns = ["export_id","timestamp","route_id","user_id","tokens","amount"]
```
Deepa (Eng): The trick is ensuring stable export_id for retries; I'll generate export_id as sha256(export_timestamp + job_id). Low-risk.
Aisha (CS): Impact/ freq: procurement rejection = critical (affects renewal), frequency=every finance audit. Truncation issue (they also mentioned long clinical notes cut mid-sentence) = medium, freq~5% exports.
Marco (PM): Owners? Deepa for the PR (schema + stable id). Aisha will prepare the manual reconciled CSV and attach customer sample. Tom to push procurement context + signoff once manual CSV delivered.
recon-bot: Created tasks RW-4720 (add-export-id-to-csv), RW-4721 (console-per-route-columns), RW-4722 (manual-audit-bundle). Linked to account "SummitCare-Pilot" and flagged RW-4721 as P0.
Aisha (CS): I'll upload the customer's sample export and the auditor checklist. Also scheduling a 30m demo with procurement on Thursday to walk through the one-off CSV.
Deepa (Eng): ETA for manual CSV: 3 hours after I get sample. ETA for PR: 2 days including a small migration job to backfill export_id for recent exports.
Marco (PM): Good. If manual CSV goes out today, we should see procurement unblock. We'll decide on console vs API in next sprint planning. Thanks team :pray:
